text:
Maya: Quick heads-up  we're instituting a release embargo starting Fri 2026-05-22 17:00 UTC for any changes touching runtime, model packaging, or quantization plugins. Plan merges before then or file an exception.
Tariq: Noted. Does this include infra change to Dedicated autoscaler rules?
Maya: Yes. Autoscaler, pool resizing, and GPU type swaps are in-scope. Exceptions require a short RFC in #release-approvals + my ping.
Sasha: Canary update: we're rolling embedding-v2.4 to 3% next Wed. Observability hooks are enabled; latency and error-rate alerts will gate ramps.
Nina: We have two enterprise customers pinned to q8 quant builds. Any special rollback guidance?
Maya: For quant changes: must include the compatibility matrix, replay tests, and a documented rollback runbook. We'll keep a canary with sticky routing for 72h before full ramp.
Sasha: Canary kick command (internal tool):
```
rlsctl canary start --target embedding-v2.4 --pct 3 --duration 72h --sticky
```
Tariq: Will DeployBot block PRs automatically during embargo? Trying to avoid mid-night surprises.
DeployBot: DeployGuard: Blocking merges labeled [runtime, model, quant] during embargo window. Use /freeze-exception to request bypass.
Eng-SRE Oncall: We're scheduling a standby window Fri 17:00-19:00 UTC. Pager rotation adjusted; reach out on-call for fast rollback assistance.
Maya: If anyone expects hotfixes (security/critical), follow the freeze-exception flow and include the test run id. I'll triage approvals.
Nina: I'll update the customer comms draft and add an FAQ about pinned quant builds.
Sasha: Added perf regression checklist to the release docs. Tag me for any telemetry gaps.
Maya: Please confirm owner acknowledgement in-thread by Thu EOD so we can lock the train. :lock:
